rule: local[B] = local[B] * C_B for every frame; C_B ~ inverse(local_DB[B]) * local_REF[B] (game-local x,y,z,w), re-expressed as a model-space correction and mirror-symmetrized (left/right averaged) when symmetrize=true
note: Offsets are measured vs the game reference female idle. unsymmetrized_* = plain inverse(local_DB)*local_REF.

crouch.doc: Moving-crouch posture class (applied by crouch_posture.py to GASP clips AFTER the shoulder/neck offsets above; not part of 'offsets'). Per frame weight w = smoothstep((hips_z - z_lo)/(z_hi - z_lo)) from the ORIGINAL hips height, so idle-depth frames (<= z_lo, ~0.47-0.50 m) stay bit-exact and the deep loop frames (>= z_hi) get the full correction. Hips z -= min(w*hips_drop_m, max(hips_z - hips_floor_m, 0)) (Root frame, Root is identity; the floor = crouch-idle depth keeps the knee flexion within what the GASP idle/turn clips already use); spine chain pitched back about the model X axis by w*spine_bend_deg, distributed over spine_chain (cumulative fraction of the bend per bone, model-space pitch added to the ORIGINAL global orientation; spine_bend_deg is tuned so the Hips->Neck lean falls from ~49 to ~28 deg in the loops, because the pitch of a bone only moves the segments below it); neck_chain (Neck 2/3, Neck1 1/3, Head 0) hands the pitch back so the HEAD keeps its original model-space orientation; arm_chain gives the upper-arm pitch as a fraction of the spine bend (0.5 = half follow, 0 = restore original orientation; 0.5 keeps the hands >= 3.9 cm from the thigh axis, 0 gives 1.7-3.1 cm). Legs: analytic two-bone IK per frame keeps both ankles at their original model-space positions (knee plane kept), foot orientation restored; so foot position/velocity features of the DB are unchanged.

headlock.doc: Head-lock posture class (applied by head_yaw_audit.py apply to retargeted clips; not part of 'offsets'). For Neck, Neck1 and Head: R = conj(G_Spine3)*G_bone (bone in the Spine3 frame); D = R*conj(R0), R0 = mean relative pose over M_Neutral_Stand_Idle_Loop; yaw = heading of D*f0 about the chest axis a (Spine3->Neck direction in the Spine3 frame; f0 = model +Y of the reference pose projected perpendicular to a). Correction R' = Rot(a, -w*yaw)*R: the yaw relative to Spine3 is zeroed for all three bones, pitch/roll are kept; descendants (eyes) keep their local rotation. Weight w: loops (loop_regex) w = 1 on every frame (the correction is a pure function of the frame pose, so closing loops keep closing and there is no seam whip); other clips w = max(smoothstep(min(frame, last-frame)/(blend_s*fps)), 1 - edge_residual_deg/|yaw|), i.e. a 0.1 s ramp at both edges that never leaves more than edge_residual_deg of yaw (a clip that starts/ends with a constant 60 deg yaw would otherwise whip by that angle in 0.1 s). Selection: max |Head yaw| of the clip > yaw_threshold_deg AND the name does not match threshold_exclude_regex (the default skips the native GASP clips, whose head leads turns/strafes by up to 60-80 deg by authoring: 377 of 718 GASP clips would be hit; head_yaw_audit.py apply --all-sources removes that exclusion). Clips outside the selection are copied byte for byte.

launch.doc: Run/sprint start launch-lean cap (applied by launch_posture.py to the GASP standing start clips AFTER the offsets above; not part of 'offsets'). Per frame lean = angle(Neck - Hips, +Z) of the ORIGINAL pose; frames with lean <= knee_deg stay bit-exact; above it the lean is mapped to knee + (cap - knee) * tanh((lean - knee) / (cap - knee)) (C1, asymptote cap_deg). The excess is removed by a backward pitch about the horizontal axis perpendicular to the frame's lean direction: pelvis_share on Hips (pivot = Hips joint), the rest over spine_chain (cumulative fraction per bone, model-space pitch on the ORIGINAL global orientation), iterated so the result lands on the capped lean; neck/head/arms keep their pose relative to the chest. Hips raised by raise_m_per_deg * removed lean (at most to frame-0 height - min_drop_m, and never so far that a leg straightens past reach_max of its length; that cut is smoothed over lift_smooth_frames). Legs: two-bone IK keeps both ankles at their original model-space positions with the original knee hinge carried (crouch_posture knee-fix construction), foot orientation restored. Source: 2026-11-09 gametest (V folds ~57 deg at run start; GASP source FBX Run_Start_F 59-61 deg, run cycle 20-31 deg, GASPALS 1.2 Relaxed run start 41.6 deg).
